documents.title: Clarification With Respect To Disclosure Appearing On Portal Of BSE / NSE
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Meeting Of Executive Committee Of The Board Of Bhagyanagar India Limited Held On 13.08.2026 - Preferential Allotment Of Equity Shares
In-Principle Approval Under Regulation 28(1) Of SEBI ( LODR) Regulations, 2015
Corrigendum To Extra-Ordinary General Meeting ("EGM") Notice, Dated 30.06.2026
Submission Of Voting Results Along With Scrutinizer Report

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported its Q1FY27 financial performance with a revenue of INR 70,507.54 lakhs and a PAT of INR 2,024.52 lakhs, alongside a sales volume of 5,278 MT. The company is progressing with a composite scheme of arrangement involving the amalgamation of Bhagyanagar Copper Pvt. Ltd. and the demerger of its non-copper/other assets into Tieramet Ltd. Additionally, management announced a preferential allotment of equity shares to raise INR 52.25 crores for general corporate purposes and working capital requirements.

guidance.claim: Management targets a 25% CAGR for the next 3 to 4 years to double turnover to 5,000 crores by the year 2030.
guidance.quote: We are, in 5 years, we are planning to... 3 years, and we are planning to double the turnover to 5,000 crores, which translates in Between 20% to 25% CAGR. 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: Management expects to maintain a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year on an increased top line.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

guidance.claim: Out of the projected 25% growth, the company expects 20% volume growth and a 5% increase in prices.
guidance.quote: Out of the 25%, we are expecting 20% volume growth and 5% increase in prices.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted a growing sustainability focus and supply constraints that are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.

demand_outlook.claim: Short-lead-time scrap material coming from the Gulf has suddenly dried up, and shipping lines have been diverted.
demand_outlook.quote: The scrap coming from Gulf, which is of a short duration, short lead time material, has suddenly dried up. And, the material which is coming from the rest of the world, the shipping lines have been diverted because a lot of shipping lines have a transit point in Dubai or somewhere in the Gulf before coming to India.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's dependence on scrap from the Gulf is less than 5% of its material.
demand_outlook.quote: We are dependent on scrap from Gulf to less than 5% of our material comes from Gulf.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has proposed a capex of 40 crores in the next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: Installed capacity reached 35,000 metric tonnes this year with the new 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.
capex_expansion.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

margins_costs.claim: In Q3 and Q4, the company achieved around 5% EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: In Q3 and Q4: e We’ve achieved around 5% EBITDA, and 2.2% and 2.5% of PAT.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, which is very high compared to our peers, and as you can see, over the four quarters, our EBITDA per kg has been trending upwards.

margins_costs.claim: In quarter four, the company achieved around 62 rupees per kg in EBITDA.
margins_costs.quote: With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

orders_capacity.claim: Copper sales volume increased by 34% from 18,000 metric tonnes last year to 24,000 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

capital_allocation.claim: The total fund raise through preferential allotment is slated at INR 52.25 Crores.
Working capital increased from 157 crores to 230 crores, which management stated is proportional to revenue.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our working capital has gone up from 157 crores to 230 crores. And this increase in working capital is proportional to our revenue, so there's no, no reason to be concerned.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores during this financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are looking at a fundraise. We are still not, come up with a final proposal, but we are looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that forwarding statements are subject to risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially.
risks_headwinds.quote: These statements are subject to risk and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially from those anticipated.

management_commitments.claim: The government mandated that all new products made from non-ferrous metals must contain a minimum of 5% recycled content starting from FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Government has mandated that all new products made from non-ferrous metals must contain a minimum of 5% recycled content (starting from FY28)

management_commitments.claim: The company is proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management hopes to execute the fundraise in this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We hope to do it in this financial year, definitely.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
